title: Seokju Kang
text:
Seokju Kang


Ph.D. Candidate @ UNIST





Hello, I’m Seokju Kang. I am currently a Ph.D. student in Management Engineering at UNIST, supervised by Prof. Hyun Jin Jang. Prior to that, I completed my B.S. in Industrial Engineering at Pusan Nat’l University.


My research domain is in Financial Engineering, with particular emphasis on risk management, derivatives pricing, and quantitative methods in finance. I am also working on AI/OR applications in finance. For further details, please visit the list of my papers and projects.




E-mail: jukang@unist.ac.kr
